verdict.rationale: Mercury ships one official SDK, the Stainless-generated Go library MercuryTechnologies/mercury-go. The evidence states there is no official npm or PyPI SDK, only community packages such as n8n-nodes-mercury. Developers in other languages get generated code samples on the API reference, an llms.txt index that advertises OpenAPI-formatted endpoints, and an official CLI and agent skills, but the common OpenAPI spec paths returned 404 when probed. Missing for 10: official SDKs for major languages like TypeScript/Node and Python, a directly retrievable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of the Go SDK.
